components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag set on create to acknowledge that this owner
            intentionally shares a household with an existing owner (same last
            name and address). When true, the duplicate-household check is
            bypassed and the owner is created anyway.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last

              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-

                LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and
                NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more
                than the number of owners at the time this owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0011'
              readOnly: true
            pets:

              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

              items:

          required:

   - Derives a **stable** identifier `HH-<12 hex chars>` from the SHA-256 of the normalized last name + address (same normalization as the duplicate check — case/whitespace-insensitive), so every owner in the same household deterministically gets the identical value regardless of creation order.
   - Back-fills that id onto any already-existing household members that lack one, so "both" owners genuinely share it.

The acceptance test (`coreJoinersShareHouseholdId`) confirms two joiners with the same last name + address and `sharesHousehold: true` receive an equal, non-blank `householdId`.

I implemented the `sharesHousehold` / `householdId` feature in this Spring Boot PetClinic REST app. The existing code already handled the *bypass* half (a `sharesHousehold` flag that skipped the duplicate-household rejection); what was missing was assigning and returning a stable shared `householdId`.

Changes:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added a read-only `householdId` string property to the `Owner` schema (alongside `customerCode`). The DTOs are generated from this spec at build time, so `OwnerDto` now exposes `householdId`, and MapStruct maps it automatically by matching field name.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — Added a `household_id` column field with getter/setter.

3. **Schema files** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — Added the `household_id` column to the `owners` table. Tests run under `hsqldb` with `ddl-auto=none`, so this is required for the field to persist and be read back via `GET /api/owners/{id}`.

4. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — In `addOwner`, when `sharesHousehold` is true, instead of running the duplicate-household rejection it now calls `assignHousehold(owner)`, which:
   - Derives a **stable** identifier `HH-<12 hex chars>` from the SHA-256 of the normalized last name + address (same normalization as the duplicate check — case/whitespace-insensitive), so every owner in the same household deterministically gets the identical value regardless of creation order.
   - Back-fills that id onto any already-existing household members that lack one, so "both" owners genuinely share it.

The acceptance test (`coreJoinersShareHouseholdId`) confirms two joiners with the same last name + address and `sharesHousehold: true` receive an equal, non-blank `householdId`.

One notable snag: an Edit inadvertently left a NUL byte as the string delimiter in the source (which silently broke grep and Edit matching); I replaced it with a proper `"\n"` escape and verified no NUL bytes remain.
